# Probe: attribute values never seen in training (post-hoc; generated by scripts/probe_unseen_values.py)

A second fictional population (5,000 people, seed 2127) with entirely new names, towns, occupations, employers, clubs and streets, generated with the same code and templates. 800 test tickets with the original templates and 800 with the shifted templates, from the same authors. S3 is the detector trained in run 2 (run-2 model loaded from disk); no model is retrained on the new values. The attacker uses the new vocabularies and the new 5,000-person register. 95% bootstrap intervals over tickets.
